items.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
items.snippet: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.

items.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
items.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

items.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
items.snippet: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
